name: auto-list-products
description: Discovery-first product listing for any web admin backend: probe the form, record what it looked like, then crop, fill, verify, submit - and diff the next probe against that record when the platform moves.

interface.shortDescription: Bulk-list products on any admin backend.
interface.longDescription: Auto-List-Products probes your own admin form once and keeps two artifacts: what the form looked like (probe dump) and what we decided to do about it (profile). Then it runs a resumable listing queue: square image crops with blank and carousel-dot guards, existing assets laid into the declared slots, fact extraction, optional registration sheet, browser form filling with per-field verification before each submit, an audit pass against the live product list, and a probe diff that tells you when the platform changed underneath the profile.
defaultPrompt: Probe my store admin's create form and prepare it for bulk listing.
Crop these product screenshots and build a listing queue.
Audit the products I just submitted for blank images and duplicates.
Check whether the store admin changed since my last probe.
